verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is marketed explicitly as a passkey/WebAuthn security key that stores credentials on-device rather than in a cloud, and general FIDO2 passkey support inherently implies discoverable/resident credentials for usernameless sign-in ([solokeys-docs-2], [solokeys-docs-9], [solokeys-gh-1]). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resident-key storage limits/technical FIDO2 conformance details, and independent hands-on confirmation of a usernameless login flow (only marketing copy corroborates this).
